title: Fix marquee initial empty state and repetition
description: Inspect the homepage model marquee empty-start behavior, review the Magic UI marquee docs, and update the implementation so repeated copies are present immediately with no empty region.

title: Ensure marquee loops with no empty gaps
description: Adjust the homepage model marquee so the asset cards repeat seamlessly with no empty space visible during scrolling.

title: Make marquee models scroll slowly
description: Adjust the homepage marquee so the model cards visibly scroll horizontally at a slow steady speed while continuing to render.

title: Keep marquee model previews rendering continuously
description: Fix the homepage marquee so the real GLB previews do not disappear after one pass and continue rotating/rendering as the cards loop.

title: Fix conflicting asset route slug names
description: Resolve the Next.js dynamic route conflict under app/api/assets where different slug names are used for the same path depth, causing npm run dev to fail.

title: Fix upload 400 from invalid custom file IDs
description: Uploading an image fails with 400 Bad Request and browser error 'Custom Id cannot contain :'. Investigate client uploader configuration and ensure uploads show visible success state before generation begins.

title: Fix DATABASE_URL missing error during local signup
description: Investigate why signup fails in local dev with Docker DB running and npm run dev showing 'Missing DATABASE_URL. Configure PostgreSQL before using the app.' Ensure local development reads the expected env config or falls back correctly so signup works when the database is up.

title: Fix DragDrop styling regression
description: The restyled Uppy DragDrop area appears to have disappeared or become unusable. Inspect the actual Uppy classnames and correct the CSS so the dropzone remains visible and functional.

title: Add explicit multi-view role assignment in upload UX
description: Finish the multi-view submission flow so users can assign front, back, left, and right roles per uploaded image. Persist the correct role per asset and keep server-side validation as the source of truth.
acceptance_criteria: Multi-view uploads support explicit per-image role selection and valid role combinations submit successfully to generation jobs.

title: Harden real Hi3D submission, polling, and callback handling
description: Verify and harden the production Hi3D contract for task submission, status polling, and callbacks. Add robust error handling, callback validation/authentication if supported, and ensure result download remains reliable when callbacks are delayed or dropped.
acceptance_criteria: Real Hi3D jobs can complete through callback or polling fallback with actionable failure states and secure callback handling.

title: Prepare production worker, storage, and queue operations
description: Document and implement the production operating requirements for PostgreSQL, Redis, the background worker, and durable object storage. Add health checks or operational verification paths for the app and worker runtime dependencies.
acceptance_criteria: Production infrastructure requirements are codified and operators can verify database, queue, worker, and object storage readiness before launch.

title: Replace demo-user flow with real authentication
description: Remove the x-demo-user production dependency and implement server-side authenticated user resolution for uploads, generations, downloads, and admin access. Client code should stop sending demo identity headers directly.
acceptance_criteria: Authenticated users can create and access only their own assets and jobs without using x-demo-user headers.

title: Productionize real Hi3D image processing
description: Prepare the application to process real user images against Hi3D in production. This umbrella tracks the required implementation and operational work across authentication, upload UX, Hi3D integration hardening, infrastructure, and launch operations.
acceptance_criteria: All child beads needed for production launch are completed and the application can process real Hi3D jobs in production.

title: Remove upload move-around illustration
description: Remove the upload area illustration or affordance that suggests the picture can be moved around, while keeping the upload UI functional.

title: Move Arabic copy into locales/ar.json
description: Why this issue exists and what needs to be done: the app currently hardcodes Arabic UI copy across pages and components. Centralize all Arabic strings into a single locales/ar.json file and update the app to read from it while keeping the existing RTL and date formatting behavior.

title: Use real asset previews in homepage marquee
description: Replace the mock gradient cards in the homepage Marquee with previews based on the files under assets/ so the exhibition wall reflects the bundled sample models.

title: Fix homepage preview gallery marquee becoming empty
description: The homepage preview gallery slides once and then leaves empty space instead of continuously looping. Update the marquee implementation so preview cards repeat seamlessly with no blank gap.

title: Inline upload progress after generation start
description: Replace the post-upload redirect to /jobs/[jobId] with inline progress on the home upload page. Reuse generation polling, show clear step progress with percentage, and surface a download action once the result is ready while keeping the standalone job route available for direct/admin access.

title: Protect admin access and add launch-grade observability
description: Restrict the admin surface to authorized operators and improve production visibility into job lifecycle failures, retries, and result download problems through structured logging or operator-facing diagnostics.
acceptance_criteria: Admin access is restricted and operators have sufficient visibility to diagnose failed or stuck production jobs.

title: Restyle Uppy DragDrop
description: Make the Uppy DragDrop uploader look native to the site by overriding its default styles to match the existing visual system.

title: Fully implement RTL across app
description: User requested full RTL implementation beyond the existing document direction and font setup. Audit and update the app for RTL-safe layout, language metadata, and directional utilities.

title: Make exhibition wall a single row of five cards
description: User requested the Exhibition wall section display as one line with only five cards instead of two marquee rows with six cards.

title: Simplify uploader UI
description: Remove the descriptive left-side submission panel from the upload form and replace the embedded Uppy Dashboard with the simpler DragDrop uploader UI.

title: Simplify landing page sections
description: The current landing page feels noisy and crowded. Reduce the homepage content so it only keeps the Exhibition wall and Submission studio sections, removing the rest of the landing-page sections and extra promotional copy.

title: Redesign frontend with Tailwind and Magic UI
description: Add Tailwind and shadcn to the Next.js app, introduce Magic UI-compatible components, and redesign the homepage, job page, and admin page into a cohesive gallery-style experience while preserving existing upload and job flows.

title: Add Magic UI MCP project config
description: Why this issue exists and what needs to be done: add a project-level OpenCode config that registers the Magic UI MCP server using the correct OpenCode mcp schema so the repo can use it locally.

title: Make the site RTL and use thmanyahsans font
description: Update the Next.js app UI to support RTL layout across the upload, job, and admin pages, and switch typography to the thmanyahsans/ font files in the repo. Ensure layout, spacing, tables, forms, and status/timeline components render correctly in RTL.

title: Replace local JSON/filesystem MVP persistence with production stack
description: Replace the current local JSON DB (data/db.json) and filesystem storage (data/storage/**) with the production architecture from plan.md: PostgreSQL for users/assets/jobs/events, Redis + BullMQ for background jobs, and S3/R2 for uploads/results. Preserve current API behavior while migrating storage, job orchestration, and result download flow.

title: Replace local persistence with Postgres, Redis/BullMQ, and object storage
description: The initial implementation uses local JSON and filesystem storage so the MVP runs in an empty repo. Follow up by migrating jobs/assets/events to PostgreSQL, background work to Redis/BullMQ, and uploads/results to S3/R2 per plan.md.
notes: Only remaining blocker: generate Cloudflare R2 secrets and provide R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID and R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY via untracked production environment variables.

title: Add explicit multi-view role labeling and real auth
description: The current UI supports multi-view validation server-side, but still needs explicit front/back/left/right assignment in the upload flow and real user authentication/ownership instead of the demo-user header before production use.
close_reason: Split into ab3ad-h9v for real authentication and ab3ad-2qk for explicit multi-view role assignment.

title: Implement plan.md MVP 3D generation service
description: Implement the initial MVP described in plan.md, adapting to the existing repo structure. Include upload flow, generation job tracking, Hi3D integration scaffolding, and UI/API pieces that fit the current stack.

title: Update AGENTS.md with current project guidance
description: Refresh AGENTS.md so it reflects the current ab3ad MVP architecture and working conventions, while keeping the file under 100 lines.
